entry.title: Demonstration of quantum-digital payments
entry.subtitle: Peter Schiansky; Julia Kalb; Esther Sztatecsny; Marie-Christine Roehsner; Tobias Guggemos; Alessandro Trenti; Mathieu Bozzio; Philip Walther · 2023-06-29 (Nat. Commun. 14, 3849; received 2023-01-12, accepted 2023-06-15)

fields.label: Authors
fields.text: Peter Schiansky; Julia Kalb; Esther Sztatecsny; Marie-Christine Roehsner; Tobias Guggemos; Alessandro Trenti; Mathieu Bozzio; Philip Walther

fields.label: Version
fields.text: Corrected version of record (after 2023-08-21 correction) read 2026-10-11. arXiv:2305.14504 v1 2023-05-23, v2 2024-01-08 (not diffed).

fields.label: Correction status
fields.text: Author Correction 2023-08-21, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-40866-x (Nat. Commun. 14:5059): replaces one Discussion sentence about unbounded number of purchases (MAC key growth). No numbers, equations or figures changed. See research/CORRECTIONS.md.

fields.label: Precise theorem
fields.text: No numbered theorem. SI Note 3: N=1 SDP eq.(14) minimising adversary error e at declared loss l; asymptotic boundary eq.(16)-(18) M(e,l)=(4+2 sqrt2) e + l <= (1/2)(1-p_m/2); finite-N Chernoff estimates eqs.(19)-(23); reported p_d=5.911e-45 at N~4.2e6 (sub-token, per cryptogram bit), MAC forgery p_t=1/sqrt|C|.

fields.label: Input model
fields.text: SPDC heralded entangled source; TTP measures one photon in H/V or D/A creating (b,B); other photon sent over 641 m fibre; multiphoton p_m; Fock-diagonal (no photon-number coherence) assumption.

fields.label: Verifier model
fields.text: TTP (bank) verifies cryptogram kappa_i against (b,B) and m_i=MAC(C,M_i) with tolerated errors/losses; merchant forwards to TTP (online bank verification - not offline local validation).

fields.label: Adversary capabilities
fields.text: Malicious client/merchant/third party; arbitrary CPTP map on token (N=1 SDP); untrusted quantum and classical channels except initial client-TTP key setup; TTP honest. Coherent attacks across N addressed only by a de Finetti argument stated qualitatively (SI Note 3B).

fields.label: Proof dependencies
fields.text: SDP duality; Choi; Chernoff-Hoeffding (SI eqs 7-8); exponential de Finetti (SI ref 15); i.t.-secure MAC (Wegman-Carter style, SI Note 2D).

fields.label: Datasets
fields.text: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7979319 (cited v1, 153,143,236 B) - newer version 10.5281/zenodo.7997998 exists (290,067,249 B; adds tagfile_example/). CC BY 4.0 in Zenodo metadata; archive contains LICENSE_CC_BY.

fields.label: Code
fields.text: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8020667 (Archiv.zip 24,642 B, md5 efae565e...): acquisition/coincidence scripts only; NO SDP or security-analysis code; file LICENSE_AGPLv3 inside archive conflicts with Zenodo metadata 'cc-by-4.0'; imports a missing module find_start_alt; requirements.txt referenced but absent.

fields.label: License
fields.text: Article CC BY 4.0. Data CC BY 4.0. Code: Zenodo metadata CC BY 4.0 but bundled LICENSE_AGPLv3 -> treat as AGPL-3.0 (most restrictive) until clarified. Patent application EP 23168897.9 (University of Vienna) per competing interests.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.text: Online provider verification (not instant local validation); verification delay tens of minutes; finite-N treatment via Chernoff on combined 'mishaps'; numbers inconsistent between main text and SI; experiment uses two merchants only.

fields.label: What QMint adds
fields.text: Independent re-derivation of the N=1 SDP and recomputation of Fig.4/SI Table 2 from the deposited timetags (L1). Any QMint optimisation of N/delta trade-offs for D1 must cite this paper as the source of the bound and show improvement against its published tuple.
